title: 第701章 翱翔云端第700章 伟大旅程
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可望着四周无边无际蓬松的云海，满心惊叹。
“要是我不知道这是云雾，我早就一头扎进去了。”艾可怅然感慨眼下无法如愿，暗暗下定决心，日后一定要创出一门能穿行云海的功法！
“我还以为你会待在船舱里？”梅轻轻碰了碰艾可，伸手揽住她的腰。
“晚点再进去。”艾可点了点头，“航程才刚刚启程，一直闷在舱内总觉得别扭。”
“真是出乎意料。”梅轻笑一声，操控飞舟调整航向。
“这座飞盘的力量波动时常变化。”艾可察觉到异样，只是随口一提。过多质问或是出言冒犯都毫无益处，因此她言语十分谨慎。
“我们正在避开大大小小宗门的阵法结界，以防行程横生变故。”一位长老目光专注地驾驭飞盘，平静开口。
“那我们要如何找到中途歇脚之地？”艾可更好奇这件事，想要补给休整，就必须降落地面。
“落脚点大致早已敲定。”梅淡淡一笑，“是当年大迁徙浩劫过后，一座座废弃的城池与村落……”她微微眯起双眼。
“我听不懂你在说什么。”艾可故作懵懂地哼了一声，但明眼人都看得出来，她心里清楚这场浩劫正是因她而起。
“不过倒也帮了我们大忙。浩劫过后，各大宗门不敢贸然向外扩张，我们才有机会从容赶路。”梅低声笑道。这场浩劫对无数势力而言是灾难，却给想要逃离此地的众人创造了契机。
“行程真能一路安稳吗？”艾可歪了歪头。大批宗门都参与过当初的入侵行动，她不认为前路会一帆风顺。
“别随口说不吉利的话。”梅伸手捏了捏艾可的脸颊。
“又来——”艾可委屈嘟囔，已经一个多月没人捏她脸颊了！
……
旅途漫长，总共计划停靠两到三处据点，具体要看催动巨型飞舟的诸位长老体力消耗情况。
驾驭飞舟之人修为必须足够高深是有原因的，一旦驶入茫茫大洋上空，根本无法随意落地休整。梅为此早已拟定好万全方案。
“前路漫漫，大家都做好准备。”媛轻轻推了推两人，二人回过神摇了摇头。
“喂，我只是提醒一下而已嘛。”媛鼓着嘴，转身不再打扰她们。
“船舱里的床铺怎么样？”梅想多了解这艘小型灵舟。

“勉勉强强。大部分地方我都想重新改造一番。”艾可神色认真地说道，设施简陋到实在难以忍受！
“你真是个挑剔小家伙。”梅轻叹一声，倚靠在船舷边。
“品质低劣的东西，我实在没法将就。”艾可跟着叹气，坐下来靠在低矮的船栏上。
“觉得无聊了？”梅挨着艾可坐下。
“有点疲惫，灵力持续消耗实在……”艾可微微一颤，灵力流失的程度远超预料。好在身处高空，她能源源不断吸纳太阳精气。
虽说吸纳的精气勉强能够抵消旅途消耗，可体内灵力不断外泄的感受依旧令人难受。
所幸维持自身运转无需额外消耗本源精气，不然这艘灵舟恐怕早已缓缓下坠。
“这种消耗也让人昏昏欲睡。”艾可揉了揉双眼。
“这很正常，很少有机会承受这般持续的灵力损耗。”梅缓缓点头。她清楚这般负荷已经接近极限，但航程耗时并不会太久，不会对艾可造成永久性损伤。
“哼，那你可得再加把劲了。”艾可打着哈欠打趣梅，万万没想到自己会困成这样。
“还有力气顶嘴？”梅本想调侃回去，可看着艾可一副萎靡倦怠的模样，终究不忍，任由她静静适应灵力流失的状态。
“我们回船舱吧。”梅伸手扶艾可起身。
“床铺归我。”艾可提前警告道。
“自然。”梅轻笑，搀扶着艾可走进舱内。
……
艾可一头倒在床上，转瞬沉沉睡去。
“睡得真快。”梅望着她怔了片刻，轻轻吻了吻艾可的脸颊。
“好好歇息……”梅浅笑着，轻手轻脚走出船舱，生怕惊扰熟睡的艾可。
梅刚踏出船舱，几位长老立刻上前。
content_en:
Ai Ke looked at the boundless fluffy sea of ​​clouds all around, filled with wonder.
"If I didn't know it was clouds, I would have plunged into it a long time ago." Ai Ke lamented that he couldn't do what he wanted at the moment, and secretly made up his mind to create a technique that can travel through the sea of ​​clouds in the future!
"I thought you would stay in the cabin?" Mei touched Aiko lightly and put her arm around her waist.
"Go in later." Ai Ke nodded, "The voyage has just started, and I feel uncomfortable being stuck in the cabin all the time."
"It's really unexpected." Mei chuckled and controlled the flying boat to adjust its course.
"The power fluctuation of this flying disk changes from time to time." Ai Ke noticed something strange and just mentioned it casually. There's no point in asking too many questions or being offensive, so she's very careful with her words.
"We are avoiding the formation barriers of large and small sects to prevent unexpected changes in the schedule." An elder said calmly while controlling the flying disc with his eyes focused.
"Then how do we find a resting place on the way?" Aike was more curious about this matter. If he wanted to replenish his supplies and rest, he had to land on the ground.
"The destination has been roughly decided." Mei smiled faintly, "It's the abandoned cities and villages after the great migration..." She narrowed her eyes slightly.
"I don't understand what you're talking about." Aike snorted pretending to be ignorant, but anyone with a discerning eye could see that she knew in her heart that this catastrophe was caused by her.
"But it did help us a lot. After the catastrophe, the major sects did not dare to expand outwards rashly, so we had the opportunity to move forward calmly." Mei laughed softly. This catastrophe was a disaster for countless forces, but it created an opportunity for everyone who wanted to escape from this place.
"Is the trip really safe all the way?" Ai Ke tilted his head. A large number of sects had participated in the original invasion, and she didn't think the road ahead would be smooth sailing.
"Don't say unlucky words casually." Mei reached out and pinched Aiko's cheek.
"Again -" Ai Ke muttered aggrievedly. No one had pinched her cheek for more than a month!
…
The journey is long, and we plan to stop at two to three strongholds in total. The details will depend on the physical exertion of the elders who drive the giant flying boat.
There is a reason why the person who pilots the flying boat must have a high level of cultivation. Once it sails over the vast ocean, it is impossible to land and rest at will. Mei has already drawn up a comprehensive plan for this.
"The road ahead is long, everyone should be prepared." Yuan gently pushed the two of them, and they came to their senses and shook their heads.
"Hey, I'm just reminding you." Yuan puffed her lips and turned around to stop disturbing them.
"How are the beds in the cabin?" Mei wanted to know more about this small spiritual boat.
"Barely. I want to renovate most places." Ai Ke said seriously, the facilities are so simple that it is unbearable!
"You are such a picky little guy." Mei sighed softly and leaned against the side of the boat.
"I really can't deal with low-quality things." Ai Ke sighed and sat down to lean on the low railing of the boat.
"Are you bored?" Mei sat down next to Aiko.
"I'm a little tired. The continuous consumption of spiritual power is really..." Ai Ke shuddered slightly, and the degree of spiritual power loss was far greater than expected. Fortunately, being high in the sky, she could continuously absorb the energy of the sun.
Although the absorbed energy can barely offset the consumption of the journey, the feeling of the spiritual energy in the body constantly leaking out is still uncomfortable.
Fortunately, there is no need to consume additional energy to maintain its operation, otherwise this spiritual boat would have slowly fallen.
"This kind of consumption also makes people drowsy." Aike rubbed his eyes.
"This is normal. It is rare to have the opportunity to endure such continuous spiritual power loss." Mei nodded slowly. She knew that such a load was close to the limit, but the voyage would not take too long and would not cause permanent damage to Echo.
"Hmph, then you have to work harder." Ai Ke teased Mei with a yawn, never expecting that she would be so sleepy.
"Do you still have the energy to talk back?" MeiI wanted to tease her back, but seeing Ai Ke's listless and tired look, I finally couldn't bear it and let her quietly adapt to the loss of spiritual power.
"Let's go back to the cabin." Mei stretched out her hand to help Aike stand up.
"The bed belongs to me." Aike warned in advance.
"Of course." Mei chuckled and helped Ai Ke into the cabin.
…
Aike fell on the bed and fell asleep instantly.
"I fell asleep so quickly." Mei stared at her for a moment, then kissed Aike's cheek gently.
"Have a good rest..." Mei smiled lightly and walked out of the cabin quietly, fearing to disturb the sleeping Aike.
As soon as Mei stepped out of the cabin, several elders immediately stepped forward.
